data.title: Legend Biotech Names Novartis Veteran Ingrid Zhang as CEO to Lead Next Phase of CAR-T Growth
data.description:
Legend Biotech ( (LEGN) ) has issued an update.

Legend Biotech Corporation is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on cell therapies, headquartered in Bridgewater, N.J. With more than 3,000 employees, it is the largest standalone cell therapy company and a pioneer in CAR-T treatments for cancer. Its flagship product is CARVYKTI®, a one-time CAR-T therapy for relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, developed and marketed in collaboration with Johnson & Johnson. The company is building an end-to-end cell therapy platform to expand patient access and advance a pipeline of innovative cell therapy modalities.

Legend Biotech operates primarily in the United States but serves global markets, positioning itself at the forefront of the CAR-T cell therapy revolution. By combining scientific innovation with operational scale, it aims to transform patient outcomes in oncology and strengthen its long-term growth profile in the competitive biopharmaceutical landscape.
